>
[Chaos Falcon Feather](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3257)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Catalyst" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=791" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 118

**Price** 10 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When used as catalysts, _chaos falcon feathers_ lend flexibility to spells that deal with elemental energy. For the duration of a catalyzed [_resist energy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1651) spell, you can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) the Spell on an adjacent target, touching them and changing the type of energy to which they have resistance. This reduces the remaining duration of the spell by 1 minute; if the spell has less than a minute remaining, it reduces the duration to 1 round.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
